wikipedia.pt: Movimento Popular de Libertação de Angola

names: Movimento Popular de Libertação de Angola
People's Movement for the Liberation of Angola
summary: One of the three Angolan movements, based in Luanda and among the assimilated and urban population, and the one that held the capital at independence in 1975.
